statement: No arrangement of 10 straight lines has 26 bounded triangular faces. Hence K(10) <= 25; together with the existing exact 25-face construction, K(10) = 25.

scope.convention: all parallel and finite multiple-point patterns are free
scope.formulation: faces-only monolith, justified without loss by the proved face/broad collapse theorem
scope.face_constraints: triangle-crossing indicators forced false, with global and per-line face-capacity bounds

generator.regeneration: byte-identical to the certified CNF (cmp exit 0)

independence.role: independent second upper-bound certificate; the prior cube-cover theorem did not depend on this monolith

soundness: Every 10-line arrangement with 26 admissible triangles can, by the proved collapse theorem, be replaced by 26 triangular arrangement faces. Such a face family extends the necessary all-degeneracy CNF. The checked DRAT refutation therefore rules out 26 and proves the upper bound independently of the earlier cube cover.
